svg.title: Food on the Grid
svg.desc: Top-down maps of the 128 m floor with every food orb placed at world start by food::place, at three densities, and the spawn pad where every creature is seated.
svg.text: Food on the Grid: where the orbs lie at world start
food::place(&FoodSettings::new(density, 0)) on the 128 m x 128 m terraced floor; density in orbs per 100 m² of open floor
Orbs drawn 4x their true 0.25 m radius. Shading: terrace level; cyan lines: risers taller than a 0.1 m climb. x runs right, z runs down.
